notes: Input for fetch-type-photos.mjs. Type codes whose type_names.json entry carries a same_as article use that article unless articles names one for the code; the codes under articles name the English Wikipedia article for a type that has none there, or a variant or family article whose Wikidata image is usable when the type's own is not. Each was resolved through the MediaWiki API with redirects followed and checked to have a Wikidata item. A family article stands in for a variant (Boeing 747 for the 747-200).

files names a Commons file for a type whose Wikidata image is unusable; the tool skips Wikidata for that code and applies the same license, size and content checks. titles gives the photo's title for a code that the type table does not name.

classes lists the representative photo for each class of aircraft, which cards show when a type has no photo: its Commons file, title, the ICAO Doc 8643 descriptions it covers and, for jets, the type_names.json categories that tell a business jet from an airliner. A photo that lists the type's category wins over one that lists descriptions only.

skip lists codes that get no type photo, with the reason. rejected lists Commons files a visual check found unsuitable. authors gives the credit line for a file whose Commons author field is not a plain name. descriptions gives reviewed alt text and, optionally, the variant or model pictured (shown) or a full caption for files that passed the visual check.
